meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能基于 claude-mem 的观察记录构建语料库,把相关记录载入会话形成“知识脑”,然后回答你关于其中内容的提问;还能列出、重建和重新加载这些语料库。
howto.when: 当你要求基于 claude-mem 的观察历史建立专项知识库、询问过去的工作模式,或汇总某个主题的经验时,此技能会启用。

say.text: 加载 hooks-expertise 语料库,我要开始提问
say.note: 执行 prime_corpus 载入会话

say.text: 用 hooks-expertise 回答:5 个生命周期钩子各在何时触发?

howto.what_en: Claude can build corpora from claude-mem observations, load them into a conversational session to form a knowledge brain, answer questions about that content, and list/rebuild/reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create focused knowledge bases from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic, this skill engages.

say_en.text: Create a corpus 'hooks-expertise' from recent hooks observations
say_en.note: Runs build_corpus to make a knowledge base

say_en.text: Load the hooks-expertise corpus; I'll start asking questions
say_en.note: Runs prime_corpus to open a session

say_en.text: Ask hooks-expertise: when does each of the 5 lifecycle hooks fire?
